**Privacy policy updated.** The popup now keeps two numbers in the
extension's own local storage: how many sorts you have started, and whether it
has asked for a review yet. That lets it ask once, after your third sort,
instead of on every visit. Nothing is sent anywhere, and Instagram and TikTok
cannot read it. See [Bug reports and reviews](https://github.com/andreadorizza/open-feed-sorter/blob/v0.2.0/PRIVACY.md#bug-reports-and-reviews).

- **Report a bug** in the popup opens a bug form with your version filled in.
- **Copy debug info** copies the version, browser, site and how the tab's last
  sort ended. It never includes the profile name or any post.
- No GitHub account? Email andreadorizza@gmail.com.
